name: The Green Hills of Stranglethorn

meta.next: Chapter I, Chapter II, Chapter III, Chapter IV

summary: Barnil Stonepot was trusted to proofread the manuscript for Hemet Nesingwary's novel, but a fierce gust of wind scattered the loose pages across the jungle. To spare him his master's anger, you are asked to scour the wilds, assemble the missing pages into four complete chapters, and return the finished work.

sections.title: A Scattered Manuscript
sections.body: Following your arrival in the expedition camp after Welcome to the Jungle, Barnil Stonepot finds himself facing a disaster. While reviewing the draft of Hemet Nesingwary's novel, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn, a sudden gale caught the loose leaves and flung them into the wild. Though he managed to recover a fair portion of the work, many sheets remain lost in the brush. To keep his master from discovering the mishap, he needs every misplaced page tracked down and compiled into Chapter I, Chapter II, Chapter III, and Chapter IV.

sections.title: Preserving the Hunter's Tale
sections.body: Bringing back the four completed sections spares Barnil from an unpleasant confrontation with Nesingwary. With the chapters gathered safely in hand, he hopes the restored work will soon find its way into libraries across the world.

faq.q: Who wrote The Green Hills of Stranglethorn?
aliases: author of green hills of stranglethorn
faq.answer: The novel was written by the expedition's leader, Hemet Nesingwary, who entrusted the draft to Barnil Stonepot for proofreading.
A powerful gust of wind blew directly through the hunting camp while Barnil was reviewing the manuscript, scattering the loose sheets across the jungle.

faq.q: What is needed to finish the manuscript?
faq.answer: You must collect the scattered pages and assemble them into four distinct parts: Chapter I, Chapter II, Chapter III, and Chapter IV, then hand the full set to Barnil.

faq.q: Where did this assignment come from?
aliases: how do i get this quest
faq.answer: Barnil offers this job at the expedition camp in Stranglethorn Vale after you complete Welcome to the Jungle.

faq.q: What does Barnil intend to do with the restored novel?
faq.answer: Beyond saving himself from Nesingwary's wrath, Barnil expects the completed manuscript will eventually be distributed to libraries across the world.
